opening.argument: The footage shows a Fronto app promotion with gift-card options, including a Target gift-card item, and the description asks viewers to download the app, sign up, and use a referral code. Those are the actions this material requests in connection with the advertised rewards. The supplied evidence does not establish a payment request, credential collection, deception, or a completed reward outcome. The request to share is a separate, ordinary engagement request. On this record, the video presents an app rewards promotion, not an established scam.
